Entries.Title: TV5
Entries.Description: TV5 is a major Philippine television network offering a mix of local and international programming, including news, entertainment, and sports.

Entries.Title: A2Z (ABS-CBN)
Entries.Description: A2Z is a Philippine free-to-air blocktime broadcast television network based in Quezon City, with its studios located in Ortigas Center, Pasig. It serves as a flagship property of ZOE Broadcasting Network, the broadcast media arm of Jesus Is Lord Church Worldwide, in partnership with ABS-CBN Corporation as its main content provider through a blocktime agreement.

Entries.Title: Dirty Ice Cream
Entries.Description: Villagers are experiencing an extreme heat. Two hot ice cream vendors come to the village to sell ice cream. With electricity out, the women of the subdivision take turns having the vendors satisfy their every needs.

Entries.Title: Rita
Entries.Description: Rita, who finds herself alone when husband Ariel works abroad. They both find solace and sexual satisfaction in other people. When Ariel comes back, they both act like nothing happened. But will this keep their marriage from falling apart?

Entries.Title: Triangle
Entries.Description: Story about a happily married couple visited by an old friend, who ends up stirring the pot by becoming sexually involved with both the husband and the wife.

Entries.Title: Kiskisan
Entries.Description: A steamy tale of love, lust, and betrayal. When Adele's sister Bea returns with her girlfriend Cheska, a secret affair begins between Cheska and Adele's boyfriend, Rener, leading to a climactic ending when they're caught.

Entries.Title: Wanted: Girlfriend
Entries.Description: Sheina Yu and Reina Castillo date a man who likes to have sex anytime and anywhere. See who can keep up with his strong sexual appetite and be his girlfriend.

Entries.Title: Bigayan
Entries.Description: A gay couple has been in an open relationship for seven years. But when one of them proposes on having a more exclusive set-up, will the other give in to keep their relationship?

Entries.Title: Kaskasero
Entries.Description: A talented mechanic and driver, Migs quickly finds success when a customer he likes, Gabbi, leads him into the life of street car racing. But as he goes along this life and learns of Gabbi’s past, Migs makes rash decisions that might put the brakes on their relationship.

Entries.Title: F-Buddies
Entries.Description: Jas learns that his boyfriend has been cheating on her. He breaks up with her because she’s boring. So to prove him wrong, and just to continue to be with him, she agrees to a fuck buddy set up with her ex.

Entries.Title: Boss Ma'am
Entries.Description: V.A.D. and Charm try to outplay each other in a game of deceit. When a terror female boss was blackmailed by her assistant, she has no choice but to obey and play with her.

Entries.Title: Katas
Entries.Description: Carmina, who works as a maid in a mansion and soon learns about the dirty secret of their masters, Alex and Grace.

Entries.Title: Salawahan
Entries.Description: All eyes are on Vivamax Queen Angeli Khang as she is being shared by not one, not two, but three hot leading men. Melaine can't get enough with the two men in her life. When a new man arrives, she gives in to temptation.  Director: JEFFREY HIDALGO  Cast: ANGELI KHANG, ALBIE CASINO, SHEILA SNOW, VAN ALLEN ONG, ITAN ROSALES

Entries.Title: Init
Entries.Description: When a young barrio lass moves in to the city to study, she lives in a boarding house with other college students. Unknown to them, behind her shy and timid personality is a woman with insatiable hunger for sex.

Entries.Title: TL
Entries.Description: Brenda, a top agent in a BPO company, is always overlooked for promotion. But not this time; as she gets more than intimate with her TL. Is her long awaited position within her reach? Or did she just put herself in a bad situation?

Entries.Title: First Taste
Entries.Description: Yuna, a woman engaged with her long time boyfriend, Nicco, starts to have second thoughts when she meets again her first love, Becca. Now she is torn between the man she loves and the woman she first loved.

Entries.Title: Maharot
Entries.Description: Tantan, a small-town young man, falls for Joni, a free-spirited woman who sells herself yet teaches him about love. As their bond deepens, will their love defy life's twists?

Entries.Title: Bedspacer
Entries.Description: Janice's steamy obsession to imitate Lexi propels them to campus stardom. But dark secrets blur the lines between authenticity and seductive deception.

Entries.Title: EKS
Entries.Description: Three compelling stories in one erotic experience. Yen Durano plays three different women in three titillating stories. In a collaboration of three directors: Roman Perez, Jr., Sigrid Polon, and Omar Deroca.

Entries.Title: Cita
Entries.Description: A young woman who secretly sleeps with her husband’s son. The two form an alliance to kill her husband but fate has other plans for Cita.

Entries.Title: Pantasya ni Tami
Entries.Description: Tami, with the help of her fubu photographer, Ken, sells sexy photos of herself. When she meets her fan, Gelo, who loves her as she is, she is torn whether to leave cosplaying or leave Gelo.

Entries.Title: Sisid Marino
Entries.Description: A married couple falls into depression after the death of their child. They turn to sex as a coping mechanism, but poverty takes its toll on them.

Entries.Title: Jurassic World Rebirth
Entries.Description: Five years after the events of Jurassic World Dominion, covert operations expert Zora Bennett is contracted to lead a skilled team on a top-secret mission to secure genetic material from the world's three most massive dinosaurs. When Zora's operation intersects with a civilian family whose boating expedition was capsized, they all find themselves stranded on an island where they come face-to-face with a sinister, shocking discovery that's been hidden from the world for decades.

Entries.Title: Night Carnage
Entries.Description: A blogger who is also a werewolf meets a dashing playboy with a dark secret of his own. Starring Logan Andrews and Christian Howard.

Entries.Title: Creation of the Gods II: Demon Force
Entries.Description: Taishi Wen Zhong led the army of Shang Dynasty including Deng Chanyu and four generals of the Mo Family to Xiqi. With the help of Kunlun immortals such as Jiang Ziya, Ji Fa led the army and civilians of Xiqi to defend their homeland.

Entries.Title: The Pickup
Entries.Description: A routine cash pickup takes a wild turn when mismatched armored truck drivers Russell and Travis are ambushed by ruthless criminals led by savvy mastermind Zoe.

Entries.Title: How to Train Your Dragon
Entries.Description: On the rugged isle of Berk, where Vikings and dragons have been bitter enemies for generations, Hiccup stands apart, defying centuries of tradition when he befriends Toothless, a feared Night Fury dragon. Their unlikely bond reveals the true nature of dragons, challenging the very foundations of Viking society.

Entries.Title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle
Entries.Description: As the Demon Slayer Corps members and Hashira engaged in a group strength training program, the Hashira Training, in preparation for the forthcoming battle against the demons, Muzan Kibutsuji appears at the Ubuyashiki Mansion. With the head of the Demon Corps in danger, Tanjiro and the Hashira rush to the headquarters but are plunged into a deep descent to a mysterious space by the hands of Muzan Kibutsuji.  The destination of where Tanjiro and Demon Slayer Corps have fallen is the demons' stronghold – the Infinity Castle. And so, the battleground is set as the final battle between the Demon Slayer Corps and the demons ignites.

Entries.Title: Ne Zha 2
Entries.Description: After a catastrophic event leaves their bodies destroyed, Ne Zha and Ao Bing are granted a fragile second chance at life. As tensions rise between the dragon clans and celestial forces, the two must undergo a series of perilous trials that will test their bond, challenge their identities, and decide the fate of both mortals and immortals.

Entries.Title: M3GAN 2.0
Entries.Description: After the underlying tech for M3GAN is stolen and misused by a powerful defense contractor to create a military-grade weapon known as Amelia, M3GAN's creator Gemma realizes that the only option is to resurrect M3GAN and give her a few upgrades, making her faster, stronger, and more lethal.

Entries.Title: Phantom
Entries.Description: In 1933, when Korea was under Japanese occupation, five people in Gyeongseong are suspected to be "Phantom" spies of the anti-Japanese organization.

Entries.Title: Superman
Entries.Description: Superman, a journalist in Metropolis, embarks on a journey to reconcile his Kryptonian heritage with his human upbringing as Clark Kent.

Entries.Title: Guns Up
Entries.Description: When a job goes horribly wrong, an ex-cop and family man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city.

Entries.Title: Ice Road: Vengeance
Entries.Description: Big rig ice road driver Mike McCann travels to Nepal to scatter his late brother’s ashes on Mt. Everest. While on a packed tour bus traversing the deadly 12,000 ft. terrain of the infamous Road to the Sky, McCann and his mountain guide encounter a group of mercenaries and must fight to save themselves, the busload of innocent travelers, and the local villagers’ homeland.

Entries.Title: Karate Kid: Legends
Entries.Description: After a family tragedy, kung fu prodigy Li Fong is uprooted from his home in Beijing and forced to move to New York City with his mother. When a new friend needs his help, Li enters a karate competition – but his skills alone aren't enough. Li's kung fu teacher Mr. Han enlists original Karate Kid Daniel LaRusso for help, and Li learns a new way to fight, merging their two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

Entries.Title: Ballerina
Entries.Description: Taking place during the events of John Wick: Chapter 3 – Parabellum, Eve Macarro begins her training in the assassin traditions of the Ruska Roma.

Entries.Title: Bride Hard
Entries.Description: Sam is a secret agent whose toughest mission to date is pleasing her bride-to-be best friend at a lavish destination wedding. When a team of mercenaries crashes the party and takes the guests hostage, Sam is thrown into a fight unlike any before — one where she can’t risk blowing her cover or ruining the big day. As she takes on the bad guys in a high-stakes battle disguised as a fairy-tale affair, she realizes the real threat might be closer than she thinks.

Entries.Title: Man with No Past
Entries.Description: Waking up in an unfamiliar city, a man with no memory must confront the mysteries of his own identity. However, his desperate search to uncover the past pits him against a powerful enemy, leading to a showdown that ultimately reveals the truth.

Entries.Title: Thunderbolts*
Entries.Description: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, seven disillusioned castoffs must embark on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.

Entries.Title: Almost Cops
Entries.Description: When an overeager community officer and a reckless ex-detective are forced to team up, plenty of chaos ensues on the streets of Rotterdam.

Entries.Title: xXx
Entries.Description: Xander Cage is your standard adrenaline junkie with no fear and a lousy attitude. When the US Government "recruits" him to go on a mission, he's not exactly thrilled. His mission: to gather information on an organization that may just be planning the destruction of the world, led by the nihilistic Yorgi.

Entries.Title: F1
Entries.Description: Racing legend Sonny Hayes is coaxed out of retirement to lead a struggling Formula 1 team—and mentor a young hotshot driver—while chasing one more chance at glory.

Entries.Title: Lilo & Stitch
Entries.Description: The wildly funny and touching story of a lonely Hawaiian girl and the fugitive alien who helps to mend her broken family.

Entries.Title: The Fantastic 4: First Steps
Entries.Description: Against the vibrant backdrop of a 1960s-inspired, retro-futuristic world, Marvel's First Family is forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, while defending Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic Herald, Silver Surfer.

Entries.Title: The Bad Guys 2
Entries.Description: The now-reformed Bad Guys are trying (very, very hard) to be good, but instead find themselves hijacked into a high-stakes, globe-trotting heist, masterminded by a new team of criminals they never saw coming: The Bad Girls.

Entries.Title: Ne Zha
Entries.Description: A young boy is born as the reincarnation of a demonic power, into a society that hates and fears him. Destined by prophecy to bring destruction to the world, Nezha must choose between good and evil to see if he can change his fate.

Entries.Title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
Entries.Description: Ethan Hunt and team continue their search for the terrifying AI known as the Entity — which has infiltrated intelligence networks all over the globe — with the world's governments and a mysterious ghost from Hunt's past on their trail. Joined by new allies and armed with the means to shut the Entity down for good, Hunt is in a race against time to prevent the world as we know it from changing forever.

Entries.Title: Un Reino Para Todos Nosotros
Entries.Description: Fran and Serendín are brothers and live in the Gran Arrabal. They both dream of one day leaving their town and traveling to The Kingdom, a paradise on earth sheltered behind great walls.For that they will have to ride The Beast, a huge creature that merchants use to transport goods to The Kingdom. An unexpected situation complicates Fran and Serendín's plans, separating them.Sister and brother will embark on an adventure to meet again and at the same time find themselves, in a fantastic world divided by visible and invisible borders.

Entries.Title: Angels Fallen: Warriors of Peace
Entries.Description: When an Iraq War veteran receives a calling from a higher power, he embarks on a mission to stop a fallen angel from raising an army of the dead to take over the world.

Entries.Title: A Minecraft Movie
Entries.Description: Four misfits find themselves struggling with ordinary problems when they are suddenly pulled through a mysterious portal into the Overworld: a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master this world while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected, expert crafter, Steve.

Entries.Title: Moana 2
Entries.Description: After receiving an unexpected call from her wayfinding ancestors, Moana journeys alongside Maui and a new crew to the far seas of Oceania and into dangerous, long-lost waters for an adventure unlike anything she's ever faced.

Entries.Title: The Green Dinosaur
Entries.Description: When the world around him is mysteriously erased, a little green dinosaur named Diplodocus must travel through the pages of a comic book and adventure through time to bring color back to his land. Alongside a wizard and two scientists, Diplo’s plans go awry as he learns that there may be a dimension to his world that he never considered.

Entries.Title: SuperKlaus
Entries.Description: Santa Claus's wish comes true when he accidentally bumps his head and starts believing he's SuperKlaus. With the help of Billie and Leo his elf-xecutive assistant, SuperKlaus will take on a toy-obsessed businessman to save Christmas.

Entries.Title: Dora and the Search for Sol Dorado
Entries.Description: Dora, Diego, and their new friends trek through the perilous dangers of the Amazonian jungle in search of the ancient and powerful treasure of Sol Dorado to keep it out of enemy hands.

Entries.Title: The Twisters
Entries.Description: A deadly patchwork of destructive cyclones is on an apocalyptic path of convergence at a populated Midwest city center. There, the twisters will merge into one mega tornado that threatens to obliterate the cities for hundreds of miles around.

Entries.Title: KPop Demon Hunters
Entries.Description: When K-pop superstars Rumi, Mira and Zoey aren't selling out stadiums, they're using their secret powers to protect their fans from supernatural threats.

Entries.Title: Night
Entries.Description: Night has to trick the mother of the missing child into sleeping to save her soul.

Entries.Title: Kaiju No. 8: Mission Recon
Entries.Description: In a Kaiju-filled Japan, Kafka Hibino works in monster disposal. After reuniting with his childhood friend Mina Ashiro, a rising star in the anti-Kaiju Defense Force, he decides to pursue his abandoned dream of joining the Force, when he suddenly transforms into the powerful "Kaiju No. 8." An action-packed recap of the first season of Kaiju No. 8 and a new original episode, Hoshina's Day Off.

Entries.Title: Predator: Killer of Killers
Entries.Description: While three of the fiercest warriors in human history—a Viking raider, a ninja in feudal Japan, and a WWII pilot—are killers in their own right, they are merely prey for their new opponent: the ultimate killer of killers.

Entries.Title: Inside Out 2
Entries.Description: Teenager Riley's mind headquarters is undergoing a sudden demolition to make room for something entirely unexpected: new Emotions! Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust, who’ve long been running a successful operation by all accounts, aren’t sure how to feel when Anxiety shows up. And it looks like she’s not alone.

Entries.Title: Despicable Me 4
Entries.Description: Gru and Lucy and their girls—Margo, Edith and Agnes—welcome a new member to the Gru family, Gru Jr., who is intent on tormenting his dad. Gru also faces a new nemesis in Maxime Le Mal and his femme fatale girlfriend Valentina, forcing the family to go on the run.

Entries.Title: The Bad Guys
Entries.Description: When the Bad Guys, a crew of criminal animals, are finally caught after years of heists and being the world’s most-wanted villains, Mr. Wolf brokers a deal to save them all from prison.

Entries.Title: Mufasa: The Lion King
Entries.Description: Mufasa, a cub lost and alone, meets a sympathetic lion named Taka, the heir to a royal bloodline. The chance meeting sets in motion an expansive journey of a group of misfits searching for their destiny.

Entries.Title: Kayara
Entries.Description: A courageous and athletic teenager, Kayara dreams that she is destined to be the first female to break into the league of Chasquis - the official messengers of the Incan empire. As she learns what it takes to be a Chasqui along with its challenges, she tackles every mission she gets and discovers the ancient stories of her land and her people.

Entries.Title: Smurfs
Entries.Description: When Papa Smurf is mysteriously taken by evil wizards, Razamel and Gargamel, Smurfette leads the Smurfs on a mission into the real world to save him. With the help of new friends, the Smurfs must discover what defines their destiny to save the universe.

Entries.Title: The Girl Downstairs Extra: Promised Future
Entries.Description: Freshman Yuan Juntang applied to Minsong University in order to get closer to Zhu Zhu, whom he has had a crush on. At the university, he meets Li Shiya who used to be his idol, and takes a temporary absence from school.

Entries.Title: Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel III. Spring Song
Entries.Description: As Sakura drowns in the murky darkness of the sins she has committed, Shirou's vow to protect her at all costs leads him into a raging battle to put an end to the Holy Grail War.  Will Shirou's wish reach Sakura even as he challenges fate itself in a desperate battle against the rising tide?

Entries.Title: My Oxford Year
Entries.Description: An ambitious American fulfilling her dream of studying at Oxford falls for a charming Brit hiding a secret that may upend her perfectly planned life.

Entries.Title: Happy Gilmore 2
Entries.Description: Happy Gilmore isn't done with golf — not by a long shot. Since his retirement after his first Tour Championship win, Gilmore returns to finance his daughter's ballet classes.

Entries.Title: The Naked Gun
Entries.Description: Only one man has the particular set of skills... to lead Police Squad and save the world: Lt. Frank Drebin Jr.

Entries.Title: Heads of State
Entries.Description: The UK Prime Minister and US President have a public rivalry that risks their countries' alliance. But when they become targets of a powerful enemy, they're forced to rely on each other as they go on a wild, multinational run. Allied with Noel, a brilliant MI6 agent, they must find a way to thwart a conspiracy that threatens the free world.

Entries.Title: Marriage Unplugged
Entries.Description: Unhappy in their marriage, Suzanna and Andrew buy a male sex robot called James, who consequently uncovers the deep fractures in their relationship.

Entries.Title: Laila
Entries.Description: Sonu Model, a renowned beautician from the old city, is forced to disguise himself as Laila, leading to a series of comedic, romantic, and action-packed events. Chaos ensues in this hilarious laugh riot

Entries.Title: The Stage
Entries.Description: During the Republican era, wars and conflicts were frequent. On stage, the "Overlord" sings with resounding passion, while below, the absurd spectacle of life unfolds. They must both secure the opera troupe's livelihood and appease the audience in their seats. Once the curtain rises, how should this play be performed?

Entries.Title: Freakier Friday
Entries.Description: Years after Tess and Anna endured an identity crisis, Anna now has a daughter of her own and a soon-to-be stepdaughter. As they navigate the myriad challenges that come when two families merge, Tess and Anna discover lightning might indeed strike twice.

Entries.Title: Sorry, Baby
Entries.Description: Agnes has been sexually assaulted. But life goes on… for everyone around her, at least. When a beloved friend visits on the brink of a major milestone, Agnes starts to realize just how stuck she’s been, and begins to work through how to move forward.

Entries.Title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
Entries.Description: Sonic, Knuckles, and Tails reunite against a powerful new adversary, Shadow, a mysterious villain with powers unlike anything they have faced before. With their abilities outmatched in every way, Team Sonic must seek out an unlikely alliance in hopes of stopping Shadow and protecting the planet.

Entries.Title: Dancer in the Dark
Entries.Description: Selma, a Czech immigrant on the verge of blindness, struggles to make ends meet for herself and her son, who has inherited the same genetic disorder and will suffer the same fate without an expensive operation. When life gets too difficult, Selma learns to cope through her love of musicals, escaping life's troubles – even if just for a moment – by dreaming up little numbers to the rhythmic beats of her surroundings.

Entries.Title: Séance Games: Metaxu
Entries.Description: Social media stars unite to play METAXU, an online séance game, only to find they have unwittingly unleashed the Gates of Hell.

Entries.Title: A Working Man
Entries.Description: Levon Cade left behind a decorated military career in the black ops to live a simple life working construction. But when his boss's daughter, who is like family to him, is taken by human traffickers, his search to bring her home uncovers a world of corruption far greater than he ever could have imagined.

Entries.Title: The Accountant²
Entries.Description: When an old acquaintance is murdered, Wolff is compelled to solve the case. Realizing more extreme measures are necessary, Wolff recruits his estranged and highly lethal brother, Brax, to help. In partnership with Marybeth Medina, they uncover a deadly conspiracy, becoming targets of a ruthless network of killers who will stop at nothing to keep their secrets buried.

Entries.Title: King Ivory
Entries.Description: Based on extensive research involving law enforcement and gang members, a never-before-seen, authentic look inside the underworld of fentanyl trafficking from gangs inside the Oklahoma State Penitentiary at McAlester a.k.a. "Big Mac."

Entries.Title: Here Now
Entries.Description: The plot of the film unfolds over 24 hours during which everything happens, including a robbery. A Californian tourist, Sophie, played by Elena Kampouris, meets three young people on the beach who promise to introduce her to the Sicilian capital, but actually have a debt to pay and involve the girl. The three young men are played by Lorenzo Richelmy, Enrico Inserra and Saul Nanni.

Entries.Title: The Shawshank Redemption
Entries.Description: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden. During his long stretch in prison, Dufresne comes to be admired by the other inmates -- including an older prisoner named Red -- for his integrity and unquenchable sense of hope.

Entries.Title: The Godfather
Entries.Description: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch, Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.

Entries.Title: First Shift
Entries.Description: NYPD veteran Mike and rookie Angela tackle a high-stakes day on New York's toughest streets, diving headfirst into a vortex of danger and action. Their adrenaline-fueled pursuits and unexpected threats unfold as they navigate perilous encounters. Amidst the chaos, intense challenges forge unbreakable bonds.

Entries.Title: STRAW
Entries.Description: What will be her last straw? A devastatingly bad day pushes a hardworking single mother to the breaking point — and into a shocking act of desperation.

Entries.Title: The Roundup: Punishment
Entries.Description: 'Monster Cop' Ma Seok-do investigates an illegal online gambling business led by a former STS Baek and an IT genius CEO Chang. Ma proposes an unexpected alliance to Jang and begins hunting down the criminals.

Entries.Title: Crazy Lizard
Entries.Description: A young man climbs into the mountains to pick up a meteorite that has fallen there and is killed by something. The "thing" descends to the village and begins to eat the inhabitants one by one, terrorizing the entire island.

Entries.Title: Nudus
Entries.Description: As she awakens from a prolonged coma, a woman is shocked to learn all the details of her life her captors her captors have access to.

Entries.Title: The Substance
Entries.Description: A fading celebrity decides to use a black market drug, a cell-replicating substance that temporarily creates a younger, better version of herself.

Entries.Title: The Hangman
Entries.Description: Troubled father Leon takes son camping in Appalachia. Local cult summons evil Hangman demon. Son goes missing. Leon must confront cult, monster to find him amid rising body count.

Entries.Title: Alien: Romulus
Entries.Description: While scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station, a group of young space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life form in the universe.

Entries.Title: Conjuring the Cult
Entries.Description: After discovering his blood-soaked daughter dead in the bathtub, David Bryson attends a self-help group to help save him from his ghostly nightmares. But when a group of mysterious cult-like women offer to help him resurrect his daughter. David's choices will not just decide his fate... but the fate of his dead daughter's SOUL.

Entries.Title: The Cellar
Entries.Description: A young girl wakes up imprisoned underground, with amnesia. She must escape, unravel the mystery behind her captivity, and confront her personal struggles. A suspenseful tale of survival, truth, and inner turmoil unfolds.

Entries.Title: Apocalypse Z: The Beginning of the End
Entries.Description: When a kind of rabies that transforms people into aggressive creatures spreads across the planet, Manel isolates himself at home with his cat, relying on his wits to survive; but soon they must go out in search of food, by land and by sea, dodging many dangers.

Entries.Title: Terrifier 3
Entries.Description: Five years after surviving Art the Clown's Halloween massacre, Sienna and Jonathan are still struggling to rebuild their shattered lives. As the holiday season approaches, they try to embrace the Christmas spirit and leave the horrors of the past behind. But just when they think they're safe, Art returns, determined to turn their holiday cheer into a new nightmare. The festive season quickly unravels as Art unleashes his twisted brand of terror, proving that no holiday is safe.

Entries.Title: Spirit in the Blood
Entries.Description: After a young girl is found dead in a secluded religious mountain community, a pack of teenage girls decide to fight against the evil spirits they believe killed her by embracing their own dark nature.

Entries.Title: Smile 2
Entries.Description: About to embark on a new world tour, global pop sensation Skye Riley begins experiencing increasingly terrifying and inexplicable events. Overwhelmed by the escalating horrors and the pressures of fame, Skye is forced to face her dark past to regain control of her life before it spirals out of control.

Entries.Title: Lembayung
Entries.Description: Arum and Pica, who wanted to complete their internship at Lembayung hospital, had to face mysterious terror from a woman satan who was suspected of hanged herself in the bathroom. The situation became even more tense after they asked others for help to the point where they threatened their own lives and those closest to them.

Entries.Title: Nosferatu
Entries.Description: A gothic tale of obsession between a haunted young woman and the terrifying vampire infatuated with her, causing untold horror in its wake.

Entries.Title: Saint Catherine
Entries.Description: An orphaned girl is rescued from a satanic ritual and taken to Saint Catherine Institute for homeless youth. There she will learn new skills while facing demons that stalk her.

Entries.Title: A Quiet Place: Day One
Entries.Description: As New York City is invaded by alien creatures who hunt by sound, a woman named Sam fights to survive with her cat.

Entries.Title: Subservience
Entries.Description: With his wife out sick, a struggling father brings home a lifelike AI, only to have his self-aware new help want everything her new family has to offer... Like the affection of her owner and she'll kill to get it.

Entries.Title: Seeds
Entries.Description: A Mohawk woman is hired as a social media influencer but is caught in a deadly cat-and-mouse game as she's forced to go to war to preserve her people's heritage from corporate interests.

Entries.Title: Heretic
Entries.Description: Two young missionaries are forced to prove their faith when they knock on the wrong door and are greeted by a diabolical Mr. Reed, becoming ensnared in his deadly game of cat-and-mouse.

Entries.Title: SAKAMOTO DAYS
Entries.Description: Once the greatest hitman of all, Taro Sakamoto retired in the name of love. But when his past catches up, he must fight to protect his beloved family.

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Hit Man
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto enjoys a quiet life in retirement with his family. But one day, an old colleague demands he return to the assassin world — or face consequences.

Episodes.Title: Vs. Son Hee and Bacho
Episodes.Description: While out on an errand, Sakamoto and Shin encounter Lu Shaotang, the daughter of a mafia boss, who's on the run and targeted by twin assassins.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Sugar Park
Episodes.Description: After learning of the huge bounty on Sakamoto's head, the crew tries to enjoy a family outing at the amusement park while fending off assassins.

Episodes.Title: Hard-Boiled
Episodes.Description: With the poison-wielding hitman taken out, the Sakamotos head to their next attraction, where they're ambushed by Dondenkai Ltd's ultimate assassin duo.

Episodes.Title: Source of Strength
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto goes all out in a fierce one-on-one duel with Boiled. Meanwhile, ORDER members are tasked with handling a serial case targeting assassins.

Episodes.Title: Heisuke Mashimo
Episodes.Description: Hoping to win the million-yen prize, Team Sakamoto enters the shopping district's survival tournament and teams up with a completely clueless sniper.

Episodes.Title: Jurassic Bastard
Episodes.Description: While manning the store alone, Lu gets kidnapped by a mysterious group. Sakamoto and Shin pursue her but are halted by an invisible assassin.

Episodes.Title: Sakamoto's vs. the Lab
Episodes.Description: To rescue Lu, Sakamoto and Shin infiltrate a top-secret lab seized by assassins. Meanwhile, in the prison cell, Lu meets someone from Shin's childhood.

Episodes.Title: All Aboard
Episodes.Description: In the depths of the Lab, Shin and Heisuke join forces to take down the invisible assailant, while Sakamoto engages in an intense battle against Kashima.

Episodes.Title: Bathhouse Roughhouse
Episodes.Description: Exhausted from their battle, the crew heads to a local bathhouse but finds it too dangerous to relax. Later, a mysterious man arrives in search of Lu.

Episodes.Title: Casino Battle
Episodes.Description: The crew faces Wutang in a high-stakes casino showdown to learn who issued Sakamoto's bounty. Meanwhile, X sends a group of vicious assassins their way

Episodes.Title: Overload

Episodes.Description: Momo believes in ghosts. Okarun believes in aliens. To make each other believe what they deny, they head to a spot famous for UFO sightings and a spiritual hotspot.

Episodes.Title: Kicking Turbo Granny's Ass

Episodes.Description: Okarun and the girls try to clean up some misunderstandings with their classmates. Later, the aquatic creature reappears before Momo and Aira.

Episodes.Title: Let's Go to the Cursed House

Episodes.Title: Like, This Is the Legend of the Giant Snake

Episodes.Title: The Evil Eye
Episodes.Description: In a bid to free Okarun and Momo from the Mongolian Death Worm’s psychic power, Jiji attempts to carry them to safety but runs into a powerful entity.

Episodes.Title: You Won't Get Away with This!
Episodes.Description: Unwilling to leave Jiji behind, Okarun helps Momo escape to the surface. Momo then begins forming a plan to expose the Death Worm to sunlight.

Episodes.Title: That's, Like, Way Deadly!
Episodes.Description: Momo tries to stop the magma, but the Kito family gets in her way. The tsuchinoko shrine priest joins the fray — but so does the possessed Jiji.

Episodes.Title: We Can All Stay There Together!

Entries.Description: In a world plagued by creatures known as Kaiju, Kafka Hibino aspired to enlist in The Defense Force. He makes a promise to enlist with his childhood friend, Mina Ashiro. Soon, life takes them in separate ways. While employed cleaning up after Kaiju battles, Kafka meets Reno Ichikawa. Reno's determination to join The Defense Force reawakens Kafka's promise to join Mina and protect humanity.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Became a Kaiju
Episodes.Description: Kafka Hibino has almost abandoned his dream of joining the anti-Kaiju "Defense Force." He now works in Kaiju clean-up, disposing of the bodies of slain Kaiju and thinking back with regret to the days he spent with his childhood friend Mina Ashiro, captain of Defense Force's Third Division.

Episodes.Title: The Kaiju Who Defeats Kaiju
Episodes.Description: After turning into a Kaiju, Kafka is forced to flee. His escape is interrupted, however, by the arrival of another Kaiju...

Episodes.Title: Revenge Match

Episodes.Title: Fortitude 9.8
Episodes.Description: An unexpected incident during the exam forces Kafka to use his powers at the risk of revealing his secret.

Episodes.Title: Joining Up!

Episodes.Title: Sagamihara Neutralization Operation at Daybreak
Episodes.Description: It's time for Kafka's first mission, and he witnesses the true power of the Defense Force when a Kaiju strikes a nearby city.

Episodes.Title: Kaiju No. 9
Episodes.Description: Reno and Iharu encounter a powerful humanoid Kaiju that quickly overwhelms them. Can help arrive in time?

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Defense Force

Entries.Title: Solo Leveling
Entries.Description: They say whatever doesn’t kill you makes you stronger, but that’s not the case for the world’s weakest hunter Sung Jinwoo. After being brutally slaughtered by monsters in a high-ranking dungeon, Jinwoo came back with the System, a program only he could see, that’s leveling him up in every way. Now, he’s inspired to discover the secrets behind his powers and the dungeon that spawned them.

Episodes.Title: I'm Used to It
Episodes.Description: Around ten years ago, gates that connected our world to another dimension began to appear, leading to the rise of hunters who would traverse these gates to fight the magic beasts within. Sung Jinwoo, E-Rank hunter, is the weakest of them all.

Episodes.Title: If I Had One More Chance
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo and his party appear to have cleared a low-level dungeon, when a hidden path to an unfamiliar temple is revealed. There they encounter a set of commandments and a group of monsters that cause them absolute despair.

Episodes.Title: It's Like a Game
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo remains behind in the temple dungeon to save his few surviving party members, and with a swing from the god statue's blade, his life comes to an end—or so it seems, before he wakes up in a hospital bed.

Episodes.Title: I've Gotta Get Stronger
Episodes.Description: Having entered the instance dungeon located inside the subway, Jinwoo levels up time and time again by fighting waves of magic beasts. As he gradually makes his way forward, he finds a long stairway leading deeper underground.

Episodes.Title: A Pretty Good Deal
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo joins a party led by Hwang Dongsuk to meet the headcount necessary for a C-Rank dungeon. Joined by another temporary hire, Yoo Jinho, the party defeats beasts without much trouble, but Jinwoo has suspicions about the group's lack of a healer.

Episodes.Title: The Real Hunt Begins
Episodes.Description: While the C-Rank dungeon raid by Jinwoo and the others seems to be progressing well, the moment they step into an area covered in mana stones with a sleeping dungeon boss, things take a wrong turn.

Episodes.Title: Let's See How Far I Can Go
Episodes.Description: As Jinwoo continues his training, he completes a daily quest one day by doing more than the quest requires, and a key that leads to a certain item appears in front of him.

Episodes.Title: This Is Frustrating
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo answers a Hunter's Association request to take part in the raid of a D-Rank dungeon, where he encounters a few familiar faces.

Episodes.Title: You've Been Hiding Your Skills
Episodes.Description: At the D-Rank raid, Jinwoo is reunited with four of the Cartenon Temple survivors. Together, they explore the dungeon with Kang Taeshik and his men. After splitting up, they hear a scream, and then...

Episodes.Title: What Is This, a Picnic?
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo survives tragedy once again, but Woo Jinchul warns him that Hwang Dongsoo, an S-Rank hunter, may be after his life. Determined to grow stronger, Jinwoo teams up with Jinho to raid a succession of C-Rank dungeons, but they attract attention...

Episodes.Title: A Knight Who Defends an Empty Throne
Episodes.Description: Out of the blue, a "job-change quest" pops up in Jinwoo's window. Feeling that it may help him get stronger, he enters the gate. Inside, he fights wave after wave of enemies, culminating in a knight who brings back memories of the Cartenon Temple.

Episodes.Title: Arise
Episodes.Description: Drained from endless battle, Jinwoo sees a phantom of his past self. To overcome his own past as the Weakest Hunter of All Mankind, he struggles to find a way to clear the job-change quest.

Episodes.Title: You Aren't E-Rank, Are You
Episodes.Description: After a scheduled meeting with Jinah's teachers, Jinwoo is asked to talk to one of her classmates, Han Song-yi, who is working as a hunter. In an effort to show her the harsh reality of the job, Jinwoo takes her to a raid designated for new hunters of the White Tiger guild.

Episodes.Title: I Suppose You Aren't Aware
Episodes.Description: After being trapped inside of a red gate, Jinwoo has to contend with a bloodthirsty pack of ice elves who question his humanity.

Episodes.Title: Still a Long Way to Go
Episodes.Description: Having completed his promise to Jinho to clear 19 dungeons, Jinwoo is stronger than he was when he fought the Cerberus. In order to gather the ingredients for the Elixir of Life and save his mother, he once again enters the S-Rank Demon's Castle dungeon.

Episodes.Title: I Need to Stop Faking
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo realizes that he'll need to become even stronger in order to clear the Demon's Castle and decides to have his hunter rank reassessed.

Episodes.Title: This Is What We're Trained to Do
Episodes.Description: Before attempting to finish the Demon's Castle, Jinwoo decides to earn some money to help prepare.

Episodes.Title: Don't Look Down on My Guys
Episodes.Description: The Hunters Guild strike team is confronting the high orc shaman Kargalgan when Jinwoo crashes the fight.

Episodes.Title: The 10th S-Rank Hunter
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo officially becomes an S-Rank hunter, allowing him to finalize his preparations for the Demon's Castle.

Episodes.Title: Looking Up Was Tiring Me Out
Episodes.Description: Seeking the remaining ingredient for the Elixir of Life, Jinwoo continues his conquest of the Demon's Castle.

Episodes.Title: It Was All Worth It
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo tries to cure his mother with the Elixir of Life while preparations for the 4th Jeju Island Raid begin.

Episodes.Title: We Need a Hero
Episodes.Description: Sparks fly as the S-rank hunters spar in preparation for the Jeju Island raid.

Episodes.Title: It's Going to Get Even More Intense
Episodes.Description: As the S-Rank hunters continue fighting, they're confronted by a new magic beast resembling a humanoid ant.

Episodes.Title: Are You the King of Humans
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo arrives at Jeju Island to save the S-Rank hunters, but to do that he'll have to face the Ant King.

Episodes.Title: On to the Next Target
Episodes.Description: After no shortage of hardship, the 4th Jeju Island raid comes to a close. But for Jinwoo, the hunt never ends.

Episodes.Description: Hiiragi Utena is just an average magical girl fan who longs to be like the superheroines she idolizes. Suddenly, a mascot character offers to make her dream come true.

Episodes.Title: Her Name Is Magia Baiser!
Episodes.Description: Hiiragi's been forced into becoming a villain! Now that she's gotten a taste for BDSM, though, she's raring for more---this time, from Magia Azure.

Episodes.Description: Utena visits Enormita's evil lair, Nacht Base, where she meets Aragawa Kiwi, AKA Leoparde. Despite claiming they should be friends, Leoparde attacks her!

Episodes.Description: Tres Magia's main job is to take down Enormita, but they've got side jobs too, like maintaining appearances! They're in the middle of a photoshoot when it’s interrupted...

Episodes.Title: Neroalice in Wonderland
Episodes.Description: Utena and Kiwi meet a new member of their evil team, Neroalice. Venalita soon gives them a demonstration of what the young girl can do to their magical girl enemies...

Episodes.Description: After recent battles with Enormita, Azure wonders why she can't keep her head on straight. Stealing time for herself, she finds herself in a compromised situation.

Episodes.Description: Loco and Leber defect and want to rejoin Utena. However, first they must participate in a “team building” exercise of Utena’s wicked design.

Episodes.Title: Gushing Over World Domination!
Episodes.Description: Lord Enorme is at her wit's end with the traitorous villain who refuses to join her in her quest for world domination. Baiser finds a creative way to defeat Lord Enorme.

Episodes.Description: Everyone took a beating during the battle with Lord: both the exhausted Enormita villains and the city itself! When the magical girls show up, Utena happens to run into Azure.

Episodes.Description: Utena and the gang head to the beach for a day off. But their summer fun won't last when Enormita and the Tres Magia show up to duke it out!

Entries.Title: The Perfect Prince Loves Me, the Side Character?!
Entries.Description: After finding himself reincarnated into the world of a novel, Loneal goes to great lengths to steer clear of Prince Alec, the hero, to avoid disrupting the main storyline between Alec and the heroine, Lily. However, to Loneal's great surprise, the prince becomes infatuated with...him?! "A charming physique, such as yours, more than makes up for your lack of experience." Before he knows it, he finds himself melting into the prince's arms... Why is everything so different from the novel?!

Episodes.Title: You're the One...I've Always Longed For
Episodes.Description: Following an accident, Loneal finds himself reborn as a side character in the renowned fantasy novel, 'The Silver Prince and the Holy Bride.' As a fan of the novel in his former life, Loneal is aware of the plot, and does his utmost to avoid meddling in the developing romance between the story's primary hero, Prince Alec, and the captivating heroine, Lily. However, despite Loneal's earnest attempts, he ends up in a precarious situation. Just when he braces himself for Prince Alec's condemnation, the story's hero instead confesses to Loneal, saying, "I've always wanted to touch you..." His eyes ablaze with passion!

Episodes.Title: Let's Recreate the Magic From Yesterday
Episodes.Description: As Loneal struggles to create an antidote for the love potion, Alec approaches him with a proposition for a date, both donning their royal uniforms. Stepping outside the academy, Loneal and Alec savor their time together, free from the concerns of others. Alec surprises Loneal with a thoughtful gift—a necklace—and hints at potentially calling off his engagement with Lily. The carriage ride back is uncomfortable, and when Loneal tries to express gratitude for the gift, Alec cooly responds, saying, "Why don't we pick up where we left off yesterday?"

Episodes.Title: No Matter What Secrets You May Hold...
Episodes.Description: Venturing into the forest in search of antidote ingredients, Loneal falls prey to an attack by a mysterious hooded man. Fortunately, Alec comes to his rescue just in the nick of time. However, unsettling words from the mysterious assailant suggest that, in his previous life, Loneal might have been considered an enemy of the prince. Disturbed by this revelation, Loneal realizes he has lost the necklace gifted by Alec and, amidst the pouring rain, returns to the forest alone. Loneal is discovered by the concerned Alec. In a comforting gesture, Alec tenderly embraces Loneal, bringing warmth to his chilled heart and body.

Episodes.Title: Is This Love an Illusion?
Episodes.Description: Loneal, overwhelmed by guilt for changing the course of the original story, devises a plan to set things right. His idea  involves bringing Alec and Lily closer by inviting them to a picnic in the rose garden. However, as he witnesses them together, a pang of anguish grips his heart. Alec, who has long seen through Loneal's strategy, calmly inquires about the plan. Faced with the prince's cool and composed voice, Loneal realizes he can't keep anything from the dashing Alec.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Love You, From Morning Till Night, Forever.
Episodes.Description: Loneal is caught off guard when a sudden uniform inspection is sprung on him by the disciplinary committee. Panicking at the idea of his necklace from Alec being confiscated, Loneal is in a frenzy. However, an unfamiliar junior named Zeno steps in to help! Loneal quickly connects with the friendly and sociable Zeno but Alec, unusually moody, is displeased. With a brief greeting, Alec takes Loneal's hand and leads him into an empty classroom. Why would the prince react in such a stern way?

Episodes.Title: Thank You for Teaching Me to Love
Episodes.Description: On the quest for magical potion ingredients, Loneal and Alec venture into the forest to gather medicinal herbs. However, their expedition takes a dark turn as they delve deeper into the wilderness! Lost in the forest at night, the two now face the challenge of struggling for survival. Despite Loneal feeling disheartened, Alec's comforting words provide a source of positivity. In the secluded woods, the two discover solace in each other's company...

Episodes.Title: From the Depths of Our Beings
Episodes.Description: Having barely fended off the magical beasts, Alec, who protected Loneal, ends up poisoned. Feeling particularly powerless for lacking a sacred power like Lily's, Loneal falls into despair. In that moment, Alec's sincere and clear words echo in Loneal's mind. Fueled by a strong determination, a newfound power awakens within Loneal, and he does everything in his power to save the struggling prince!

Episodes.Title: I Adore You, Loneal
Episodes.Description: After being tasked to concoct a magical potion, Loneal decides to enlist Alec's support. The potion progresses smoothly, however, an unexpected change occurs in Loneal's body! Alec's magical power flows into Loneal, as his body grows warm and a delightful feeling runs through him. Finally, the secret of the love potion is revealed ...

So when he was forced to reincarnate, he decided to continue his studies, prince of the realm or no! But his new life has its own sets of challenges...including being a 10-year-old! What's the 7th prince/sorcerer to do?!

Episodes.Title: I Reincarnated as the Seventh Prince
Episodes.Description: A mage, lacking both talent and lineage, is burned to death by the magic he loves. He's reborn as Lloyd, seventh prince of the Saloum Kingdom, with his past memories intact. One day, in a forbidden library, he awakens a demon that wields ancient magic...

Episodes.Title: I Encountered an Adventurer
Episodes.Description: After making the Demon Grimoire his familiar, Lloyd sets out in pursuit of a dungeon with magically enchanted items and encounters Tao, a martial artist who uses Qi techniques. Lloyd assumes the alter ego of Robert and heads deep into a dungeon with her.

Episodes.Title: Like Qi Techniques and Enchantment Magic
Episodes.Description: Deep within the dungeon lies a demonic lich that has laid many adventurers to rest. After forcing Robert to escape, Tao faces the threat alone, but is overwhelmed by the difference in power. However, just as the lich is about to finish her off...

Episodes.Title: Headed Out for a Monster Hunt
Episodes.Description: With an interest in weapon enchantments and their effectiveness, Lloyd joins Albert and Sylpha on a monster hunt. After meeting Tao and reaching their destination the group encounters a pack of bearwolves, who regenerate unnaturally quickly.

Episodes.Title: The Demon Is Angry
Episodes.Description: Just when it seemed Sylpha was able to overpower the pack of bearwolves, the demon Pazuzu emits a miasma that has the knights collapsing to the ground. Once even Sylpha and Tao are rendered unable to retaliate, Lloyd finally makes his move.

Episodes.Title: Sisters, Monsters, Spellbound Swords, and Brothers
Episodes.Description: With his new bearwolf, Shiro, in tow, Lloyd visits his sister, Alieze, in order to learn how to communicate with monsters. Afterward Lloyd is reunited with another brother, Dian, a blacksmith who is seeking to create the ultimate Spellbound Sword.

Episodes.Title: I'm Going to Battle Some Assassins
Episodes.Description: The kingdom has been infiltrated by a girl named Ren from the Assassin's Guild. Upon learning of her special ability as the Poison Blighted, Lloyd tracks her back to her hideout, sneaks in, and is attacked by a group of assassins with unique abilities.

Episodes.Title: I'm Going to Meet Jade
Episodes.Description: Having formed a connection with the Assassin's Guild members, Lloyd's curiosity is captured by the leader Jade's teleportation ability. Lloyd and the others head to Lordost Manor, where the guild is happy to be reunited with Jade, until...

Episodes.Title: The Calamity Named Guisarme
Episodes.Description: Ren is confronted by the demon lord Guisarme, who has stolen Jade's body and teleportation power. Guisarme is intent on seizing the bodies of the Assassin's Guild as well, when Lloyd arrives in the neck of time to defend them.

Episodes.Title: Sylpha's Blade
Episodes.Description: As Lloyd and Guisarme engage in fierce combat, the members of the Assassin's Guild are cornered by a horde of demons. Using the control of their abilities given to them by Lloyd's spell, the Guild resists, but are gradually overwhelmed by their enemies.

Episodes.Title: Jade's Last Words
Episodes.Description: Guisarme's teleportation-powered offensive barrage leaves Lloyd perplexed. Having come to a realization, he attempts a physical attack with a magic-absorbing sword named Spelltaker, aiming to decipher the nature of Jade's stolen power.

Episodes.Title: Lloyd's Answer
Episodes.Description: Guided by Jade's will, Lloyd deciphers the spell for teleportation. Pushed to the brink, Guisarme unleashes an attack powerful enough to reduce anything to oblivion, the Mortal Dark Sphere. At long last, this climactic magic battle comes to a conclusion.

Episodes.Title: I'll Join the Church!
Episodes.Description: Lloyd's interest in divine sorcery is piqued as a means of fighting off further demonic invasions.

Episodes.Title: Jihriel's Miracles
Episodes.Description: After teleporting in the direction of a presence he sensed, Lloyd and Grim arrive in the realm of angels.

Episodes.Title: Ghoul Hunting
Episodes.Description: Having learned the divine sorcery he was looking for, Lloyd searches for some undead to test it on.

Entries.Title: WIND BREAKER
Entries.Description: Furin High School's delinquents get bad grades, but they excel at protecting their town. Then a victory-obsessed newcomer threatens the balance of power.

Episodes.Title: SAKURA ARRIVES AT FURIN
Episodes.Description: An admirer of strong people with a complete disinterest in the weak, Haruka Sakura, a loner and delinquent high school student, aims to be a fighter at the top of Furin High School. Coming from outside the city, Sakura enrolls in Furin High School, infamous for its delinquents.

Episodes.Title: THE HERO OF MY DREAMS
Episodes.Description: It is the morning of the school entrance ceremony, and Furin High School has transformed into a group that protects the town now known as the "Chime of the Wind Breaker" — Bofurin.

Episodes.Title: THE MAN WHO STANDS AT THE TOP
Episodes.Description:
Furin High School's first-year Class 1 is infamous for its group of strong fighters.

One of the students in the class, Kyotaro Sugishita, becomes furious with what Sakura said and throws a punch at him. The two begin a spectacular fight, ignoring an aloof Hayato Suo, who's carefully watching the fight, and Nirei, who's now panicking.

A tremendously loud voice echoes throughout the school, interrupting the fight between the two young men. The owner of that voice that instantly changed the mood of the entire school is none other than Umemiya, the Representative of Bofurin. Sakura and the rest look nervously up at the speakers to hear Umemiya say something completely unexpected.

Episodes.Title: CLASH
Episodes.Description: A fight breaks out between Bofurin and Shishitoren as Bofurin tries to protect the town's middle schoolers. Sakura receives a declaration of war from the group's second-in-command, Jo Togame. Sakura and one of the Four Kings of Bofurin, Toma Hiragi, tell Umemiya what happened.

Episodes.Title: A GENTLEMAN
Episodes.Description: "That’s why I'm going to take all of Furin…and you for myself!" declares Shishitoren's leader, Choji Tomiyama, as he makes his way onto Furin High School grounds. Finally, it's a one-on-one showdown between Bofurin and Shishitoren!

Episodes.Title: VOW TO FOLLOW
Episodes.Description: Tomiyama and Togame, far from worrying about their teammate who lost the battle, expel him from their team. While this peculiar spectacle shakes Sakura and the rest, Suo becomes unexpectedly emotional and wins against Minoru Kanuma, earning another win for Bofurin.

Episodes.Title: FIGHT TO WIN
Episodes.Description: It’s now time for the battle of those second-in-command: Sakura versus Togame — a fight that will set things on fire!

Episodes.Title: SUCCEEDING THE PAST
Episodes.Description: Togame can no longer hide the fact he's feeling lost. He remembers when he met Tomiyama, the fun days he had with Shishitoren, how the team changed when Tomiyama became the leader, and the things he's done himself.

Episodes.Title: UMEMIYA'S STYLE
Episodes.Description: It's now time for a one-on-one fight between Umemiya and Tomiyama. Tomiyama believed that by winning against Umemiya, he would obtain Furin High School, freedom, and a sense of fun that would rival no other.

Episodes.Title: DIALOGUE
Episodes.Description: Admitting defeat, Tomiyama tries to pass Shishitoren on to Umemiya — to which Umemiya declares, "Instead of taking over your team, we'll be friends!" Bofurin and Shishitoren are dumbfounded at this turn of events but talks progress, food is brought, and a celebratory afterparty starts.

Episodes.Title: NEW CLASSMATES
Episodes.Description: With the fights against Shishitoren over, Class 1 enthusiastically welcomes Sakura, Nirei, and Suo's return. Their classmates, brimming with interest in the details of the fights, surround them, asking questions. Sakura can't hide his bashfulness.

Episodes.Title: THE DEPENDABLE ONE
Episodes.Description: Ren Kaji, Yuto Kusumi, and Takeshi Enomoto, second-year students from the Tamon Team, start their ruling on who will be Grade Captain for first-year Class 1. Suo is the first to raise his hand, immediately nominating Sakura as the other classmates vote for him one after the other.

Episodes.Title: FOR A FRIEND
Episodes.Description: Sakura, Nirei, and Suo finish their meeting with Umemiya, the other members of the Four Kings, and other prominent leading figures and join up with Kiryu and Tsugeura on their way home.

Episodes.Title: RAGE
Episodes.Description: Sakura is a high school delinquent who, as a member of Bofurin, has vowed to “protect this town.”

Episodes.Title: CONCLUSION
Episodes.Description: Ren Kaji and the second-year senpai rush in to save Sakura and the others when a fierce attack is upon them.

Episodes.Title: Re:start
Episodes.Description: Bofurin is able to defeat every member of Natori-led KEEL and safely rescue Nagato.

Episodes.Title: SENPAI'S TEACHINGS
Episodes.Description: The battle with KEEL is now over, and one afternoon…Sakura doesn’t show up at school. Worried, Nirei contacts him and can tell over the phone that Sakura’s got a terrible cold. That day after school, Nirei and Suo, representing the first-year class 1, head to Sakura’s apartment with a care package. Sakura came from out of town, but what kind of life is he living now?

Episodes.Title: A PLACE I BELONG
Episodes.Description: Sakura deeply feels that he wasn't able to do much during the battle with KEEL. When Sakura goes to Kaji to seek some advice, Kaji bluntly says, "You need to trust them based on what you have seen." In addition, Umemiya encourages him to "Jump right out there with everything you've got!" After recovering from his cold, Sakura enters the classroom determined. He faces Nirei, Suo, and the rest of the first-year class, and begins to share his honest thoughts about being grade captain…

Episodes.Title: HIDDEN FEELINGS
Episodes.Description: Tsubakino leads Sakura, Nirei, and Suo to the home of an old man named Ito.

Episodes.Title: NIGHT STREET
Episodes.Description: As a thank you for helping Ito recover, Tsubakino takes Sakura, Nirei, and Suo to the neon-lit entertainment district of “Keisei Street,” which is full of cozy drinking establishments, mahjong parlors, and bars. The boys are overwhelmed by the atmosphere of this part of town. They head to meet up with Tsubakino when suddenly, a girl in a tattered white dress falls on Sakura. They have no chance to hear the girl’s story before a group of thugs approaches them.

Episodes.Title: SHARED FRONTLINES
Episodes.Description: Sakura, Nirei, and Suo, having saved the girl chased by thugs whose name is Shizuka Narita, run into a suited team called Roppo Ichiza, led by someone named Kanji Nakamura. The Roppo Ichiza is a strong fighting team that had many clashes with Bofurin before the school was unified. However, there is no conflict between the two groups at present. The group goes to Burlesque Bar Ougi, where Kanji and Shizuka work, and see Tsubakino pole dance while his two lieutenants are sitting at a nearby table.

Episodes.Title: SHALL WE DANCE?
Episodes.Description: The name of the group pursuing Shizuka is GRAVEL, a group of delinquents from the Sunaba District, a notorious area known for its rough reputation. They begin to rampage through Keisei Street again, this time with more members, in an attempt to capture Shizuka. However, the members of Roppo Ichiza, Sakura, Nirei, and Suo are ready to confront them! Roppo Ichiza struggles in the fight due to the overwhelming number of GRAVEL forces despite them being beaten down one after another. Meanwhile, Tsubakino, Seiryu, and Uryu wait with Shizuka at the Burlesque Bar OUGI.

Episodes.Title: SALVATION
Episodes.Description: Unable to bear anyone getting hurt because of her, Shizuka attempts to run to Shuhei Suzuri, the leader of GRAVEL, while ignoring the calls from Nirei and the others. However, she is stopped by Tsubakino, Seiryu, and Uryu. Tsubakino asks what she wants to do, to which Shizuka responds, “I want to stay with everyone!” This prompts Tsubakino to finally show the seriousness of the Four Kings. Tsubakino asks what Suzuri likes and gradually, their fists become part of a conversation, as the battle between Tsubakino and Suzuri continues.

Episodes.Title: AFTER THE STORM
Episodes.Description: “All of us will work together and become one unit.” Suzuri-led GRAVEL resolves to walk a different path “together” as they take the extended hand of Roppo Ichiza. Shizuka, whose decision would have made everyone sad, sincerely apologizes and expresses her gratitude to Tsubakino and Kanji. Just then, as they have reconciled and everyone’s feelings are in sync, a former Furin student named Endo, covered in tattoos from his back to his shoulders and arms, appears.

Episodes.Title: STRENGTH FOR ANOTHER
Episodes.Description: Sakura, Nirei, and Suo are called up to the roof of Furin High School. Waiting for them are the Four Kings, their next-in-commands, and Sugishita, who’s helping Umemiya. Having heard about the recent events from Tsubakino, Umemiya has called everyone here to tell the story of Endo, who was the mastermind behind the conflicts between KEEL and GRAVEL, and to explain the origins of the Bofurin unification. As Umemiya, Hiragi, Tsubakino, Momose, and Mizuki join Furin High School and become a part of the Bofurin; what shadow is born as a result of this?

Entries.Title: Taisho Era Contract Marriage ~ The Substitute Bride and a Soldier's Fierce Love
Entries.Description: I used to think there was no love in marriage... Until I met a fierce and passionate soldier! Despite being the daughter of a viscount, Asako is rejected by high society and treated as a nuisance by her parents. When a marriage proposal arrives suddenly for Asako's younger sister from none other than Captain Kido, a soldier known for his coldness, she doesn't hesitate for a moment. To protect her precious younger sister, Asako volunteers as... a substitute bride!

Episodes.Title: Chance Meeting - You're the One Who Will Have My Baby, Not Your Sister
Episodes.Description: Despite being the daughter of a viscount, Asako is rejected by high society and treated as a nuisance by her parents. When a marriage proposal suddenly arrives for Asako's younger sister from none other than Captain Kido, a soldier known for his coldness, she doesn't hesitate for a moment. To protect her precious younger sister, Asako volunteers as... a substitute bride!

Episodes.Title: Wedding - You Are My Wife and No One Else
Episodes.Description: Concealing the real reason behind their marriage, Asako and Shintaro go to the Tono mansion to ask for the blessing of Asako's parents. Surprisingly, they welcome the idea with open arms, and her father even offers to prepare her wedding kimono. Hiroko, her sister, gifts Asako a precious hairpin for the occasion. Delighted by her family's positive response to her marriage, Asako is excited as her wedding day arrives, however, the fleeting moment of joy is soon shattered by a cruel deed...

Episodes.Title: Newlyweds - If Only I Knew
Episodes.Description: Asako begins her new married life with the mysterious and frightening Shintaro, and things get off to a rocky start. Despite the challenges, the newlyweds persevere and head for an outing into town wearing Western clothes. Things start to brighten up for Asako after she hears Shintaro address her as his wife.

Episodes.Title: Readiness - Ready to Risk It All
Episodes.Description: Asako is more than happy to receive a surprise visit from her sister, Hiroko. However, when she overhears an unexpected exchange between her sister and her husband, she suddenly remembers why she got married in the first place. Upset that evening, Asako decides to make a bold expression of her feelings to Shintaro...!

Episodes.Title: Jealousy - Want Me All You Want, I'm Your Man
Episodes.Description: Asako and Shintaro are on their honeymoon in the seaside town of Atami.Despite being on vacation, they run into Shintaro's colleague Sasaki, who asks him to attend a banquet with military leaders. Later that night, when Shintaro returns to the inn, Asako detects the scent of perfume on him and is overwhelmed with jealousy. Understanding her intense emotions, Shintaro offers himself to her.

Episodes.Title: Friction - Not "Woman", She Is My Wife!
Episodes.Description: As Asako visits the Kido family home for the first time, she finds herself amid a conflict that has been ongoing for over twenty years between father and son. Displeased with Shintaro's father's verbal abuse, Asako speaks up, further infuriating the man. However, Shintaro's reaction to his father's disrespectful treatment of his wife is completely unexpected...

Episodes.Title: Past - You Are Enough As You Are
Episodes.Description: Feeling dejected after the trouble with Shintaro's family, Asako is surprised by an unexpected visitor, a woman who used to be Shintaro's nanny! After talking with her, Asako learns more about Shintaro's past and discovers some surprising news about him and his family. As more time with her new husband passes, Asako finds herself learning more and more about Shintaro and his feelings every day...

Episodes.Title: Future - I've Always Wanted to Be a Family
Episodes.Description: Shintaro, mentally and physically exhausted from the battlefield, meets Asako in a fateful encounter that changes everything. Even before she offered herself as a substitute bride, Asako discovers that Shintaro had taken notice of her... When all of their secrets and feelings come to light, the couple brought together by a false union forms a genuine bond and passionately comes together!

Entries.Title: Dragon Ball DAIMA
Entries.Description: Mysteriously transformed into mini versions of themselves, Goku and his friends travel to the Demon Realm to uncover the truth and find a cure.

Episodes.Title: Conspiracy
Episodes.Description: A giant castle in a mysterious world. Two shady Majin, Gomah and Degesu, watch a monitor. The monitor shows Goku and the others having a fierce battle against Majin Buu. Gomah and Degesu head to Earth to execute a certain conspiracy.

Episodes.Title: Glorio
Episodes.Description: Goku and his friends have been turned small due to Gomah's scheme. They begin preparing to go to the demon world. Goku collects his Nyoibo and looks forward to a new adventure. Then the mysterious young Majin Glorio appears!

Episodes.Title: Daima
Episodes.Description: Goku, Supreme Kai, and Glorio head out to the "Demon Realm" first. Their plane travels through space and a mysterious dimension. They arrive at the entrance to the Demon Realm, the "Third Demon World"!

Episodes.Title: Chatty
Episodes.Description: Forced to make their way through the Third Demon World on foot, Goku and his companions stop by a lone drive-in on the way. There they encounter some strange souvenirs and a rather chatty and quirky Majin woman and her husband!

Episodes.Title: Panzy
Episodes.Description: The masked Majin who appeared before Goku and his companions is a young girl named Panzy! While Glorio gives her the cold shoulder, Panzy insists on acting as their guide. The group reaches a suspicious castle!

Episodes.Title: Lightning
Episodes.Description: After encountering the Gendarmerie, the wardens of the Demon Realm, the four are forced to camp in a cave where they encounter further trouble! The enigmatic Glorio unleashes lightning magic against Goku to resolve the situation!

Episodes.Title: Collar
Episodes.Description: Goku and his companions continue their journey. But the Gendarmerie appear and bar their way again, perhaps due to them knowing the location of the Magic Collar around Panzy's neck. Can the bond with her friends save Panzy from peril?!

Episodes.Title: Tamagami
Episodes.Description: The fight with a Tamagami begins! The Tamagamis are the undefeated guardians of the Dragon Balls. Seeing Goku fight toe-to-toe with one, Panzy and the others are unable to hide their surprise. As the battle heats up, what will happen?!

Episodes.Title: Thieves
Episodes.Description: Rumors of what Goku did in the Third Demon World spread across the Demon Realm. To avoid trouble, Goku wears a disguise at the hotel, but they can't let their guard down in the Third Demon World. Thieves see through his disguise!

Episodes.Title: Ocean
Episodes.Description: Goku and his companions arrive at the mystic Second Demon World where a giant ocean spreads as far as the eye can see! The party is amazed at the new world but is immediately attacked by Gendarmerie that have been sent by Gomah!

Episodes.Title: Legend
Episodes.Description: Having regrouped with Vegeta and the others, Goku and his companions arrive at a planet that seems familiar. As they move to head out, a suspicious shadow approaches! It's the Legendary Namek who remained alone in the Demon Realm!

Episodes.Title: True Strength
Episodes.Description: Vegeta’s battle with the Tamagami is evenly matched, but forced underwater where he's not used to fighting, he finds himself struggling! Vegeta is cornered and sinks to the ocean floor. But then he finally unleashes his true strength!

Episodes.Title: Surprise
Episodes.Description: As Goku and his companions head to where Gomah is, engine trouble causes them to land on a certain planet. The place they land happens to be a surprise-filled planet where even Supreme Demon Kings are afraid to tread!

Episodes.Title: Taboo
Episodes.Description: To stop Goku's advancement, Gomah commits an unbelievable taboo! Goku and his companions can no longer proceed. Just when it seems their adventure is over, a certain someone reveals their true power!

Episodes.Title: Third Eye
Episodes.Description: The Evil Third Eye offers absolute power in the Demon Realm. King Gomah confirms its location and moves to obtain it! Will the Third Eye open on Gomah's forehead?!

Episodes.Title: Degesu
Episodes.Description: Goku and his companions finally reach Gomah's palace. But Kadem and the mighty Gendarmerie Force bar their way! Meanwhile, in the palace, Degesu takes action for his own ambitions!

Episodes.Title: Gomah
Episodes.Description: Goku and his companions face off with Arinsu. With everything on the line, their battle begins. But all of a sudden, a transformed King Gomah stands before both parties!

Episodes.Title: Awakening
Episodes.Description: King Gomah enters the battlefield and an all-out battle ensues! Goku and his companions stuggle against the power of the Third Eye. Just when it seems that all is lost, an amazing new power is awakened within Goku!

Episodes.Title: Betrayal
Episodes.Description: The battle continues to go poorly for Goku and his companions. After much hesitation, Glorio puts Arinsu's secret plan into action! As his friends watch in awe, what will Glorio's betrayal set in motion?!

Episodes.Title: Maximum
Episodes.Description: Having been restored, Goku finally surpasses his limits! To defeat the mighty Giant Gomah, who keeps regenerating through the power of the Third Eye, everyone puts in their maximum effort in an all-out battle!

Entries.Title: Enter the Garden
Entries.Description: There are two worlds. The world we live in now, The Alley; and another world, The Garden. But The Garden is a secret hidden from most, only accessible to a chosen few.

Episodes.Title: The Waiting Man
Episodes.Description: Haru, a free-spirited skater, has always felt like a misfit in a world where she’s constantly told how to behave. One day, Haru meets T.K., a mysterious man sitting next to a vending machine, waiting for someone to appear.

Episodes.Title: Fractured Reflections
Episodes.Description: Two sisters, Shao and Raizan, grow up together in the Alley, relying on each other to survive. But one day, Raizan vanishes. Shao searches for her, but years pass with no success. Then, carrying her sister's sword, Shao stumbles upon a mysterious torii gate and enters the unknown world of the Garden.

Entries.Title: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian
Entries.Description: Alya is a transfer student enjoying popularity at her new high school, often sporting a cold shoulder while earning high marks in class. She ignores her nerdy classmate, Kuze Masachika, except for when she blurts out a flirtatious line to him in Russian. Little does she know, Kuze understands Russian, though he pretends not to. Let’s see where this wacky love story takes them!

Episodes.Title: Alya Hides Her Feelings in Russian
Episodes.Description: Alisa Mikhailovna Kujo, also known as Alya, is the ice queen sitting atop the social hierarchy of Seirei Academy. Despite her cold demeanor, she often flirts with her crush, but only in Russian. However, he may know more than he lets on.

Episodes.Title: So Much For Childhood Friends
Episodes.Description: Alya runs into Masachika and Suou while they're out shopping and continues to question the nature of their relationship. Suou takes the opportunity to invite Alya out to a super spicy ramen restaurant.

Episodes.Title: And So They Met
Episodes.Description: While spending some time with her sister, Alya recounts how she met Masachika and began to think highly of him despite his slacker status. Later, Masha gets to meet him in person when he helps out the student council.

Episodes.Title: An Outpouring of Emotion
Episodes.Description: Alya is sent by the student council to mediate a conflict between the soccer and baseball teams about the use of the school fields. When the conflict comes to a standstill, Masachika saves the day and makes an important promise to Alya.

Episodes.Title: Different People, Common Undercurrent
Episodes.Description: Masachika returns home after mulling over Alya's confession. The next day, he states his intentions to make Alya student council president and finds himself increasingly distracted by Alya despite his best efforts.

Episodes.Title: A Kiss of the Indirect Variety
Episodes.Description: Yuki uses a student council task as an excuse to get Alya alone and discuss how they truly feel about Masachika. When Masachika uses time alone together to be all work and no play, Alya decides to force a romantic moment.

Episodes.Title: A Storm Arrives
Episodes.Description: Ayano confronts Masachika about his intentions to run against Yuki in the upcoming election. The student council throw a welcome party for their two new members where Masachika and Masha discuss their more hidden natures.

Episodes.Title: Student Congress
Episodes.Description: The student congress arrives and Alya finds herself wrapped up in a shocking amount of political intrigue and maneuvers. Will her teamwork and preparation with Masachika be enough to win them the day?

Episodes.Title: Rom-commy With a Chance of Hypnosis
Episodes.Description: Masachika tries to capitalize on their victory in the congress, but Alya has some conflicting thoughts about benefitting from Taniyama being ridiculed. A confiscated book leads to some shenanigans among the student council members.

Episodes.Title: Birthday Party, Much Belated
Episodes.Description: Masachika is having trouble studying for exams until Alya decides to wager a favor on how well he does. When Alya discovers she wasn't invited to celebrate Masachika's birthday, she spends several days questioning just how close they actually are.

Episodes.Title: An Unexpected Curtain-Raiser
Episodes.Description: The unexpected encounter at the parent-teacher meetings leaves Masachika weakened and sick, and more importantly, unaware of what's happening at school.

Episodes.Title: Chin Up and Face Forward
Episodes.Description: The only thing standing between the student body and summer break is the closing ceremony, where Alya and Yuki will formally address their schoolmates and begin their official candidacy for student council president.

Entries.Description: Adult animated series of original short stories which are set within the worlds of beloved video games. Each episode serves as a gateway to a new adventure, unlocking exciting worlds from beloved gaming classics and highly anticipated new titles.

Episodes.Title: Dungeons & Dragons: The Queen's Cradle
Episodes.Description: On the hunt for a dragon cult, a band of adventurers rescues a boy who's haunted by a sinister force.

Episodes.Title: Sifu: It Takes a Life
Episodes.Description: A young martial artist bent on revenge learns the true cost of his obsession.

Episodes.Title: New World: The Once and Future King
Episodes.Description: A conquering king washes ashore on a mysterious island with no army and no clue. He may need an eternity to find his purpose.

Episodes.Title: Unreal Tournament: Xan
Episodes.Description: After revolting against their corporate overlords, a group of mining robots is condemned to fight for survival in deadly arena combat.

Episodes.Title: Warhammer 40,000: And They Shall Know No Fear
