Episodes.Title: PAC-MAN: Circle
Episodes.Description: Trapped in a vast maze and pursued by ghosts, a mysterious entity summons a warrior to help it escape.

Episodes.Title: Crossfire: Good Conflict
Episodes.Description: As a looming storm approaches, two rival mercenary groups collide. Driven by their vision of the greater good, the sides face off, their lives hanging in the balance.

Episodes.Title: Armored Core: Asset Management
Episodes.Description: In a frostbitten frontier world, a legendary mech pilot learns his latest mission might hold the key to the demons that have haunted him for decades.

Episodes.Title: The Outer Worlds: The Company We Keep
Episodes.Description: An orphan from a galactic backwater crosses the cosmos to take a job at a ruthless mega-corporation in the hopes of reuniting with the girl he loves.

Episodes.Title: Mega Man: Start
Episodes.Description: As the corrupted creations of genius inventor Dr. Light rampage through Mega City, the humblest of his inventions dreams of fighting for everlasting peace.

Entries.Title: Delicious in Dungeon
Entries.Description: Dungeons, dragons... and delicious monster stew!? Adventurers foray into a cursed buried kingdom to save their friend, cooking up a storm along the way.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1: Hot Pot/Tart
Episodes.Description: After a crushing loss, Laios, Marcille, and Chilchuck quickly reenter the dungeon to save Falin, but this time, they have a foolproof survival plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2: Roast Basilisk/Omelet/Kakiage
Episodes.Description: After waking up to a tantalizing smell, Marcille receives a lecture from Senshi on a balanced diet. The crew helps an adventurer poisoned by a basilisk.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3: Living Armor
Episodes.Description: Laios and crew access a hidden area guarded by mysterious Living Armor, who appear to be protecting something potentially delicious.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4: Stewed Cabbage/Orcs
Episodes.Description: Reaching the third level of the dungeon, Senshi leads the crew to his secret vegetable garden. Later, they are accosted by a band of angry, desperate orcs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5: Snacks/Sorbet
Episodes.Description: As another group of adventurers discovers a treasure box, a swarm of bone-chilling ghosts chases Laios and his crew. Senshi, however, has a sweet plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6: Court Cuisine/Boiled in Salt Water
Episodes.Description: A starving Laios angers a mysterious elf while hunting for food in Living Paintings. Later, Chilchuck finds himself trapped with a crabby Mimic.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7: Kelpie/Porridge/Broiled with Sauce
Episodes.Description: Something's fishy on this new dungeon level! The crew crosses a treacherous lake, encountering vicious seafood and fallen adventurers along the way.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8: Raspberries/Grilled Meat
Episodes.Description: Marcille recalls when she first met Falin as young students. After a quick wash up, an inadvertent misstep lands her in deep water with an angry spirit.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9: Tentacles/Stew
Episodes.Description: The smell of meat lures in uninvited guests — among them, a familiar face emerges. To move forward, they must work together to defeat the Undine.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10: Giant Frogs/Aboveground
Episodes.Description: The crew avoid a stinging descent to the castle town, where the Red Dragon lurks. But to defeat it, they need a tight plan — and a morale-boosting meal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11: Red Dragon I
Episodes.Description: The crew finally faces the Red Dragon, but their grand strategy quickly unravels. With the beast's fury escalating, who will get the final bite?

Episodes.Title: Episode 12: Red Dragon II
Episodes.Description: A desperate search within the dragon's stomach leads to a gruesome discovery, revealing that resurrection magic alone won't be enough to restore Falin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13: Red Dragon III/Good Medicine
Episodes.Description: Falin starts acting strange in the middle of the night, leading Laios and crew to a menacing figure who wants them gone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14: Sea Serpent
Episodes.Description: Back in an upper dungeon level, Kabru and crew wake up to find their supplies missing and are ambushed on their way back to the surface.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15: Dryad/Cockatrice
Episodes.Description: Trapped in the dungeon, a concerned Senshi cooks up a nourishing meal for the famished crew — giving Marcille enough energy to come up with a plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16: Cleaners/Dried with Sweet Sake
Episodes.Description: Chilchuck figures out a way to escape the dungeon, but their ascent is halted by an unexpected encounter with an old friend in dire need of sustenance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17: Harpy/Chimera
Episodes.Description: The parties must band together to fend off an attack by vicious Harpies — but the unexpected appearance of a transformed Falin stuns everyone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18: Shapeshifter
Episodes.Description: While in pursuit of Falin, Laios and crew seek shelter from a blizzard but are overrun by Shapeshifter copies of themselves. How will they spot the fakes?

Episodes.Title: Episode 19: Hag/Nightmare
Episodes.Description: The crew is cornered by an acquaintance who demands help with a beastly problem. Later, Laios enters Marcille's nightmare and discovers her greatest fear.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20: Ice Golem/Barometz
Episodes.Description: Izutsumi proves to be a useful ally despite her lousy table manners — and aversion to eating monsters. But the crew's kindness slowly opens her up.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21: Egg/The Golden Country
Episodes.Description: With the dungeon's fate hanging in the balance, Kabru negotiates with the elves. Meanwhile, a ghost drags Laios and crew into the cursed Golden Country.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22: Griffin/Familiars
Episodes.Description: Leaving the safety of the Golden Country, Senshi ends up in the clutches of a ferocious griffin. The crew must summon help if they want to save him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23: Griffin Soup/Dumplings -1-
Episodes.Description: Back at camp, Senshi finally reveals his painful history with the dungeon. The next day, the crew is rudely awakened by a perplexing transformation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24: Dumplings -2-/Bacon and Eggs
Episodes.Description: Still wrestling with their new forms, the crew must overcome the gargoyles. Later, they descend deeper into the dungeon. What monsters will they try next?

Entries.Title: Mission: Yozakura Family
Entries.Description: Taiyo Asano has been on his own ever since his parents died and the only one who seems to care for him is his childhood friend and classmate, Mutsumi Yozakura. But Mutsumi has a secret—she is the head of a family of spies! And on top of that, her brother Kyoichiro is dangerously protective of her! To stop Kyoichiro from killing him, Taiyo and Mutsumi must take the ultimate leap—marriage! Because in the Yozakura family, family cannot kill family.

Episodes.Title: The Cherry Blossom Ring
Episodes.Description: Shy student Taiyo's life is threatened when his vice principal reveals a dark secret.

Episodes.Title: The Yozakuras' Lifeline
Episodes.Description: Taiyo and Mutsumi wed despite Kyoichiro's interference. Bomb threat leads to Taiyo's first mission.

Episodes.Title: Feelings
Episodes.Description: Taiyo's training leads to a hellish life at the Yozakura Mansion, causing anguish for Mutsumi.

Episodes.Title: Kengo/Shinzo
Episodes.Description: Mutsumi catches Kengo's incomplete report, igniting a spy game of tag as she tracks him down...

Episodes.Title: Interrogation/Date
Episodes.Description: Hotokeyama arrests Taiyo and interrogates him about Mutsumi but lacks proof.

Episodes.Title: Bug
Episodes.Description: Obsessed stalker Ayaka transfers to Taiyo's class, and aims to kill her crush after a data leak.

Episodes.Title: Government Spies
Episodes.Description: Nanao eats a bioweapon while undercover; Taiyo joins the hunt, unaware it's to kill Nanao.

Episodes.Title: The Kuroyuri Party
Episodes.Description: Mutsumi's visit to Hinagiku HQ ignites a clash between Rin and Kyoichiro.

Episodes.Title: The Flower Meaning of Kuroyuri (Black Lily)
Episodes.Description: Ex-spy Kurogao kidnaps Deputy Prime Minister for revenge; Taiyo halts livestream to face him.

Episodes.Title: The Yozakura Family Maid/Affair
Episodes.Description: Taiyo and Mutsumi are at a celebration party. Taiyo eyes a box with his dead family's info.

Episodes.Title: Yozakura Ghost Stories/Spy License
Episodes.Description: Futaba faints as she has an intense fear of ghosts and curses. Siblings aid her phobia.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break Grandpa
Episodes.Description: Ban escapes jail, takes Taiyo to club for grandkids' wedding, dodging Kyoichiro's capture attempts.

Episodes.Title: Tanpopo
Episodes.Description: Taiyo uncovers parents' tie to Yozakura. He and Shion probe their fatal end in a deadly library.

Episodes.Title: Aim for the Suite Room
Episodes.Description: Taiyo on a ship battles spies lured by Kyoichiro until a torpedo hits.

Episodes.Title: Yozakura Blood
Episodes.Description: Taiyo investigates Kawashita; drugged Nohmen takes hostages. Shinzo aids, facing tough odds.

Episodes.Title: Cleaning the Yard
Episodes.Description: Yozakura Mansion locks in all; Kyoichiro seeks ring thief; Mutsumi aids Taiyo.

Episodes.Title: Nanao’s Medicine
Episodes.Description: Nanao's mutation needs a vaccine, forcing school exit. Taiyo aids him in preserving his school life.

Episodes.Title: Yozakura Hot Spring Story
Episodes.Description: Yozakura family wins a unique hot spring trip, faces hurdles, then relaxes, but...?!

Episodes.Title: A Drug Called Tanpopo
Episodes.Description: Taiyo sneaks on a train, tracking Tanpopo, seeking Momo, and a complaint sparks suspicion.

Episodes.Title: Sun Earrings
Episodes.Description: Hakuja and Taiyo are in a fierce battle on the train, where she unveils the truth about his parents.

Episodes.Title: Yozakura Front Lines / The Blooming
Episodes.Description: Kyoichiro and Yozakura plan attack on Tanpopo's lair; Taiyo preps with Ban.

Episodes.Title: Cherry Blossom Viewing Party
Episodes.Description: Cherry blossom party lifts spirits before Skeleton Island siege on Tanpopo's plan.

Episodes.Title: Easterly Wind / Weapon
Episodes.Description: Futaba fights Akai; Taiyo's team sneaks in, repels spear with Kurosawa's aid.

Episodes.Title: Shion & Kengo vs. Chacha & Aonuma
Episodes.Description: Shinzo's Blooming wipes out mercenaries. Kawashita flees. Shion and Kengo battle Chacha and Aonuma.

Episodes.Title: Ai and Mizuki
Episodes.Description: Taiyo and Kyoichiro find a video of Nanao attacked by Mizuki, who resents society over her past.

Episodes.Title: Old Blood
Episodes.Description: Kawashita and Taiyo fight over the detonator. Taiyo's power floods Kawashita's mind with memories.

Episodes.Title: Mission Complete / Reception
Episodes.Description: Taiyo corners Kawashita, but the Yozakuras' attacks fail. Taiyo tries again. Will it succeed?

Entries.Title: X-Men '97
Entries.Description: The X-Men, a band of mutants who use their uncanny gifts to protect a world that hates and fears them, are challenged like never before, forced to face a dangerous and unexpected new future.

Episodes.Title: To Me, My X-Men
Episodes.Description: Cyclops races to find the source of new anti-mutant technology.

Episodes.Title: Mutant Liberation Begins
Episodes.Description: When Magneto is forced by the UN to stand trial, a group of anti-mutant rioters test his resolve.

Episodes.Title: Fire Made Flesh
Episodes.Description: The team is propelled into a tragic confrontation with an immortal mad scientist.

Episodes.Title: Motendo /  Lifedeath (1)
Episodes.Description: Jubilee must relive the X-Men's greatest adventures when she's transported into a 16-bit video game.

Episodes.Title: Remember It
Episodes.Description: Team members hit Genosha as UN honorees while a press event risks exposing the team's dirty laundry.

Episodes.Title: Lifedeath (2)
Episodes.Description: Storm is forced to face her worst fears in order to free herself.

Episodes.Title: Bright Eyes
Episodes.Description: The X-Men finds Sentinel inventor Bolivar Trask, realizing they've been played by a mastermind.

Episodes.Title: Tolerance Is Extinction (1)
Episodes.Description: The X-Men must unite to face a new threat.

Episodes.Title: Tolerance Is Extinction (2)
Episodes.Description: The X-Men work to settle the score before it is too late.

Episodes.Title: Tolerance Is Extinction (3)
Episodes.Description: The X-Men's dream is put to the test as mutant-human relations reach a tipping point.

Entries.Title: Chained Soldier
Entries.Description: Destructive monsters from the Mato dimension threaten the earth, while women gifted with powers from Peaches try to stop them. But to save the world, Yuuki must be willing to become Chief Kyoka's servant both on the battlefield and at home.

Episodes.Title: Birth, Yuuki, Awakening
Episodes.Description: Yuuki Wakura wanders through a gate to an alternate dimension. He meets the Demon Defense Force including Chief Kyouka Uzen, who will reward him for his servitude.

Episodes.Title: Curiosity, Shushu, Undress
Episodes.Description: Yuuki is recruited to work as a caretaker at the 7th Squadron’s dorm in Mato. Shushu catches him unaware and turns him into her boy toy. Suddenly, a giant Shuuki attacks!

Episodes.Title: Encounter, Kyouka,  Rampage
Episodes.Description: With dozens of Shuuki detected, and a score to settle, Yuuki and the Demon Defense Force Squadron take an interdimensional trip!

Episodes.Title: Whirlwind, Himari, Roar
Episodes.Description: The Demon Defense Force decides to take measures against the humanoid Shuuki. Meanwhile, Himari can adopt someone else’s ability, which she does to turn Yuuki “loyal” to her.

Episodes.Title: Sisters, Yachiho, Ridicule
Episodes.Description: Yuuki hits Yachiho with a “Brand Break,” so she rewinds to before the beginning of the match. Later, Himari appreciates Yuuki; it’s time for his reward to begin!

Episodes.Title: Blitz, Sahara, Twinkle
Episodes.Description: Up next in Round 2: It's Shushu Suruga of the 7th Squadron versus Sahara Wakasa of the 6th Squadron! And after the match, Shushu has a surprise for Yuuki.

Episodes.Title: United Front, Tenka, Soar
Episodes.Description: Tenka confronts Rairen, then uses her ability to manipulate space. Later, Yuuuki tidies up and gets a face full of more than dirty laundry!

Episodes.Title: Promise, Nei, Remember
Episodes.Description: Tenka wants Yuuki as her new pet, but Kyouka declines her request. Nei explains her clairvoyant powers, the “promise.”

Episodes.Title: Reunion, Coco, Lick
Episodes.Description: A demon who looks like Yuuki’s sister appears and abducts him! Then after the dust settles, an enemy licks Yuuki down for... medical reasons.

Episodes.Title: War, Naon, Recite
Episodes.Description: Yuuki learns a less than peachy truth. Later, he receives a finger licking good reward.

Episodes.Title: Death Match, Aoba, Excite
Episodes.Description: With Yuuki tied up and unable to fight, it’s up to the girls to harness the power of the peaches in a non-stop battle. Suddenly, those who control the demons appear...

Episodes.Title: Homecoming, New, Resolve
Episodes.Description: Yuuki finds a new reason to fight: to return Aoba to her original human form.
